play.brief: THE FORT is a top-down fort-defense game for phones. You never move: the fort sits at the centre and enemies (infantry, vehicles, aircraft, bosses) close in from every side in waves. Your commander only fires at the enemy you lock onto; squad, artillery and other defences (once bought) fire on their own. BATTLE RHYTHM: once enemies are listed near you, send 'fight enemies for 25s' (it keeps locking on for you and only stops for low hp, death, a directive or the time cap; 'fight still going after 25s' just means the cap was reached). Between orders use 'press grab' (nearest supply crate: cash and repairs), 'press frag' (grenade), 'press strike' (airstrike, once owned), 'press t' (cycle what lock-on picks). If nothing is near yet, 'press lock' then 'fight enemies for 25s' again. Every few waves a FIELD COMMENDATION offers 3 directives (dialogue): 'choose 1', 'choose 2' or 'choose 3'. When the fort falls the run ends ('call decline' if a Second Wind offer shows). At the BASE the 'game says' line lists Armory ids and prices (x = cannot afford). Calls: 'call base', 'call buy <id>', 'call research <id>', 'call deploy', 'call retreat', 'call speed <n>', 'call theater <id>'. Calls reply in words when something cannot be done. The loop is fight, fall, spend, deploy again. Judge it as a player would.
